gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5, Unspecified Version)
gpuCounters: createProgram, bufferData, texImage2D and texStorage2D calls. Regular bufferSubData streaming is excluded.
scope: Real server, seven WebSocket bots and one Chrome keyboard driver. Timed fixtures set authority inventory and emit normal pickup events, then use real firing, blast and KO paths; weapon mechanics/map definitions are unchanged. Phone viewport plus CPU throttling is a proxy, not physical phone evidence. Short samples on a busy shared Mac; random encounters and driver caching vary.
capture: Before/after map matrix uses no video. Both use Chrome timeline tracing and CPU sampling. The separate Rookie Ring controlled comparison uses video and CPU sampling on both sides. Video and no-video samples are kept separate.

softwareRenderer32DriverTest.reason: Existing test explicitly uses SwiftShader CPU rendering; reported unchanged, not used as hardware-GPU evidence.

fixes: Bounded reusable classic pickup models and compare-before-write HUD updates.
Reuse frame membership sets, LOD records, footprint bounds and detail scratch vectors.
Cache trap support independently of vertical motion; flat-patch regression changes 3744 dense point probes to one conservative range check, with unchanged 0.035m clearance.
Keep unique roof/window children and layer masks when instancing static bodies.
Preserve complete instance bounds during temporary one-instance warmup draws; Alpine cabin roof batch reproduced with bad bounds before correction.
Allow GPU fences time to finish; batch upload fences, warm exact bindings once and finish the short final batch.
Give renderer warmup its own bounded six-second budget tied to the arena generation.
knownLimits: Phone-size Chrome with CPU 4x is not a physical phone measurement.
Final natural runs range 58.77–60.01 fps, with one 83.3ms frame and one 53ms main-thread task on Rookie Ring phone; a 19.2ms MajorGC was nearby.
Final stress runs range 56.78–59.99 fps. Frosty Pass phone is 56.78 fps / 33.3ms p95 / 50ms worst. No stress main-thread long tasks were recorded.

Two texture initialization calls remain in the Bumper Blocks phone natural sample; zero shader/buffer initializations in every final natural sample, zero new GPU resource initializations in every final stress sample.

CPU render p95 median did not improve in this busy shared-machine capture (natural 5.0 to 5.8ms, stress 5.9 to 6.5ms). GC is reduced in the stress worst case but not eliminated. No universal no-lag or physical-device claim.
The camera sweep records scenery GPU submissions over 24 angles per viewport and checks instance bounds. It is not pixel-level proof for every triangle from every camera position.

repeatedCaptures.notes: An earlier classic-map capture ran at roughly 30fps during shared-machine pressure; Garden, Frosty and Neon were repeated with a fresh Chrome after the matched baseline. Both raw attempts remain. An earlier IPC-closed attempt is retained there too. A 100ms Frosty phone stress frame in that earlier capture is not hidden by the selected repeat.

reproduction.baseline: Use the same command with KART_PERF_BASELINE_REF=6ad44db and a separate output directory. Port 8300 must be free.
